title: Hornblower Boat and Walking Tour of Niagara Falls
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Take a brilliant walk with a licensed Niagara Parks Guide and learn the amazing stories, facts, and history of Niagara Falls with the people who know it and love it the best. We specialize in smaller groups of no more than 12, so you won't get lost in a huge crowd.

After your fun filled and informative walking tour you will embark on the iconic Hornblower boat ride to the Falls. Feel the thrill of being right inside the mist of the Horseshoe Falls, it will be unforgettable!

***This tour starts outside the Power Station 7005 Niagara River Parkway, and ends at the boat!
